

// package main








struct Borrowed<'a, T: 'a> {



    value: &'a T, // 


}







struct Pair<'a, 'b, T: 'a, U: 'b> {



    first: &'a T, // 





    second: &'b U, // 


}







struct Plain {



    value: u8, // 


}



fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let owner = String::from("borrowed"); let count = 3u8;



let explicit = Borrowed::<'_, String>{value: &owner} 

;


let inferred = Borrowed{value: &owner} 

;


let pair = Pair::<'_, '_, String, u8>{first: &owner, second: &count} 

;


let plain = Plain{value: count} 

;



let _: Borrowed<'_, String> = explicit; let _: Borrowed<'_, String> = inferred; let _: Pair<'_, '_, String, u8> = pair; let _: u8 = plain.value; assert_eq!(owner, "borrowed"); assert_eq!(count, 3);



    
}
